why: I checked every command in both briefs. `npm test` matches the package.json script `node --test`. The builder's `node -e "...Object.keys(m)..."`, and verifier Checks 1, 2 and 4, are valid as quoted. Bash does not expand `!` when it is followed by `=` or `(`. Verifier Check 3 breaks. It wraps the code in double quotes, so bash turns `'^#+\\s*'+f+'\\s*\\('` into the JS source `'^#+\s*'+f+'\s*\('`. In a JS string, `\s` becomes `s` and `\(` becomes `(`. That leaves `new RegExp('^#+s*adds*(','m')`, whose group is never closed, so it throws "SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression: Unterminated group". Check 3 therefore crashes on every PR, not just bad ones. Because of this one command, the briefs' commands do not all run as written.
